/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('banner.py')
before = p.read_bytes()
assert before.count(b'TITLE = \"Welome\"') == 1
after = before.replace(b'TITLE = \"Welome\"', b'TITLE = \"Welcome\"', 1)
p.write_bytes(after)
assert p.read_bytes() == after
namespace = {}
exec(compile(after, 'banner.py', 'exec'), namespace)
assert namespace['TITLE'] == 'Welcome'
assert namespace['SUBTITLE'] == 'Your workspace'
assert namespace['render']() == 'Welcome — Your workspace'
assert after.replace(b'TITLE = \"Welcome\"', b'TITLE = \"Welome\"', 1) == before
print('Verified: only the heading changed; subtitle unchanged; render() returns Welcome — Your workspace.')
PY"
